WHAT: Vinted uses catalog_ids filter to scope search to specific categories. Without this, 'watch' searches all of Vinted and returns garbage.

WHERE: lib/catalog-ids.ts — full mapping of item type strings to Vinted catalog IDs

KEY IDs (men's categories on vinted.lt):
- watches → 97
- bags/handbag/tote → 94 (men's bags)
- belt/belts → 1743
- sneakers/trainers → 1242
- sunglasses → 26
- t-shirt/tshirt/tee → 4
- jeans/denim → 16
- jacket → 258 (men's jackets)
- women's bags → 1812
- women's sneakers → 1610

HOW: getFuzzyTypeMatch(type) does lowercase partial matching — 'leather belt' → 1743, 'running sneakers' → 1242

GOTCHA: These IDs are specific to vinted.lt marketplace. Other Vinted locales (fr, de, etc.) may use different IDs. Already confirmed in memory #fxwr3g that vinted.lt uses parent categories only.

WHY: Category filter + brand filter + color filter = precise results. Without catalog_ids, search text alone is too vague for accessories.
